Buy completed. Emitted during a buy (fiat → stablecoin) flow. Payload is a
`WebhookTransactionData` with `type: buy`; `data.source` is the fiat leg and
`data.destination` is the crypto leg. `buy.awaiting_confirmation` is the
intermediate state while waiting on on-chain confirmation.
